# Description

What broke, and what now happens instead. A reviewer should not need the diff to understand
the problem.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (a command, a default or an event changes meaning)
- [ ] Documentation only

## How has this been tested?

- [ ] `Build/check.sh --fast` passes
- [ ] `Build/check.sh` passes, including the container suite
- [ ] Played by hand, and here is what happened:

**Test configuration**:

- Image tag or commit:
- Story played:

## Checklist

- [ ] The text that describes this behaviour is updated in the same change
- [ ] A test asserts the new behaviour, and it fails without the change
- [ ] Comments explain why, not what
- [ ] Nothing per-game was added — no story names, wordings or room lists in code
